hills.title: Hillside shells · rear and interior revision
hills.subtitle: More ground trees, planted rear borders, stone service faces and a walkthrough of both empty shells.
hills.footer: Actual model · two of six proposed shells. Rear landscape remains a design study; engineering and campus placement are unresolved.

hall.title: Garden Performance Hall · interactive study
hall.subtitle: Low stage, movable seating, timber ceiling, garden foyer and terrace. Use the controls inside the viewer.
hall.footer: Separate design model. Seating sightlines and finish quality still need refinement before campus integration.

site.title: Where six hillside halls could fit
site.subtitle: Proposed northern land allocation: approximately 11.53 acres including service access.
site.description: The reservation replaces existing northern recreation and overflow areas. That location has not been approved.
site.footer: A proposed land-allocation diagram, not six completed models or a surveyed site plan.

speed.title: Full-detail speed experiment
speed.subtitle: Experimental comparison. No performance improvement has been verified yet.
speed.footer: This experiment keeps the main scene detail. Actual speed and visual comparisons are still pending.

remaining.title: Other campus changes still pending
remaining.subtitle: These requested changes are not shown as completed in this package.
remaining.description: The hills and performance hall are the modeled studies in this review. Earlier preparation for the broader campus still needs integration and checking.
items: Sports layout: eight indoor pickleball courts, additional basketball and revised support areas; the revised layout is not installed in the current campus.
Landscape: replace the repeated brown grid with curved paths and useful activity areas; coordinate soccer surroundings, arrival and parking improvements.
Campus integration: place all six hillside halls, insert the performance hall, update destination labels and the tour, then check the complete visitor route.
Quality checks: test the complete model for visual clarity, movement and speed on actual computers. The existing lag has not been solved.

materials.title: Materials & accuracy
materials.subtitle: Measured model dimensions, proposed finishes and the work needed before construction.
materials.footer: Concept design. Refer to coordinated drawings, physical samples and engineering before procurement.
